buttonFallback: If the button does not work, open this link: {url}
accountFooter: You are receiving this e-mail because an account at Dominion of Steam belongs to this address.
notYou: If this was not you, reset your password at once and write to us at {support}.

verify.title: Welcome to Dominion of Steam
verify.body: good to have you on board. Please confirm your e-mail address so we can notify you when it is your turn or you receive an invitation.
verify.valid: The link is valid for {hours} hours. If you did not sign up, ignore this e-mail.

reset.title: New password for Dominion of Steam
reset.body: you have requested a new password. Set it via the link; afterwards all other devices are logged out.
reset.valid: The link is valid for {minutes} minutes. If this was not you, ignore this e-mail; your password stays unchanged.

change.title: Confirm your new e-mail address
change.body: please confirm your new e-mail address for Dominion of Steam. Only then does it apply to your account.
change.valid: The link is valid for {hours} hours. If you did not request the change, ignore this e-mail.

changed.title: Your e-mail address has been changed
changed.body: the e-mail address of your account at Dominion of Steam is now {email}. We will no longer send anything to this address.

password.title: Your password has been changed
password.body: the password of your account at Dominion of Steam has just been changed. All other devices are logged out.

notificationFooter: You choose which notifications you get by e-mail under Profile & Settings.
